block_1_metadata.author: CreativeWorkzStudio LLC / ProfessorSeanEX
block_1_metadata.role: Diagnostics Formats Subsystem Manifest indexing schemas for log serialization, streaming, and data conversion.
what_it_enables: Standardized format definitions for converting logs into structured data files
Support for fixed-column plaintext, NDJSON streams, CSV tables, deterministic replays, and audit reports
Zero-heap serialization protocols across developer and automated analysis workflows
invariants: Zero dynamic heap allocations during format parsing or generation
All formats must define strict field contracts and validation rules
Universal 5-Block Lifecycle Protocol enforced across all definitions

formats.title: Fixed-Width Columnar Plaintext Format
formats.description: Standard human-readable log output with ANSI colors, fixed character columns, and regex patterns.

formats.title: Newline-Delimited JSON Stream Schema
formats.description: Streaming JSON lines format for data pipeline ingestion, log processors, and BigQuery/ELT loading.

formats.title: Tabular CSV Export Format
formats.description: Standard RFC 4180 CSV export schema for spreadsheets, analytics, and relational database imports.

formats.title: Deterministic Replay Event Stream
formats.description: Bitwise reproducible replay log schema recording seed, input commands, and turn state hashes.

formats.title: Post-Mortem Diagnostic Audit Report
formats.description: SARIF-inspired diagnostic report aggregating preflight audit manifests and tripwire states for CI.

verification_tripwires.name: ALL_FILES_EXIST
verification_tripwires.rule: every format file exists on disk
